body:
Halfway through “A New Kind of Christianity” and I had to stop and contact you.

I know I’m learning to “embrace the mystery” and be okay with questions; however your book is giving me answers to all kinds of questions I had! It’s wonderful you’re using your God-given mind to show seekers like me that there are answers, or better yet alternatives, to the hard questions we ask. One by one you seem to hit all the objections I’ve had to the God I’ve been taught. I thank you so much.

I believe I’m evolving, just as the way you talk about Christianity evolving, to a deeper knowledge of how God wants us to live. Thanks for helping me on that journey.

 So glad you’re finding help in the book. Thanks for writing!
